one_month_reasoning: Inside the window: Q4 FY2026 results on Thursday 2026-11-19 after the close (call 4:30pm ET; company release 2026-10-29), with the first FY2027 outlook; Viavi's fiscal Q1 FY27 print on 2026-11-04 (guide revenue 450-460, non-GAAP EPS 0.40-0.42) is a read-across on data-center test demand. KEYS beat the revenue midpoint 10 of 10 quarters (median +2.4%) and EPS by a median +7.1%, so a beat on 1,930-1,950 / 3.34-3.40 is expected (ours 1,992 / 3.43; whisper 3.61). Industry prints are mixed for reactions: hyperscalers said 2027 capex rises significantly, Advantest raised its forecast, but Teradyne fell ~7% on a flat Q4 guide despite a beat, so a strong print with a cautious, supply-governed FY27 guide could still sell off. Net: slight upward drift (median ~306, +1%) at monthly vol ~13.5% (45%/3.5 plus an earnings event), tails a little fatter than lognormal. The date correction does not change the ladder (the print was inside the window either way).

comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No premium argued; KEYS sits at the median on the like-for-like basis. The 0.85x deduction is the costed post-horizon risk term (optics digestion 0.30 x -3.5, later China rule 0.10 x -1.5, 3.2T/6G 0.35 x +1.0), not a persistence call.

comps_summary.post_gate_note: Citation gate 2026-11-02 (REFRESH 1d): the whole-company peer figures this leg used failed the gate (Anritsu 28.5x and RAL 21.3-21.6x from aggregators of unstated basis/year). On stated-basis calendar NTM at 2026-11-02 the set is Anritsu 18.3, RAL 20.2, VIAV 21.4, AME 26.0: median 20.8x. With this agent's own multiple, k=0.8 and turn unchanged: exit 22.20x costed = 20.27x ex-SBC (was 20.83x). P/E leg 336.83 -> 327.83; other leg 297.9 -> 261.45; research target (12m) 327.1 -> 311.24. No 12-month ladder in this file (ladder_1m is a market ladder, unchanged); scenarios not re-run.

thesis_break_reason: At ~$218 (-28%) the stock would trade at ~14.75x the build's SBC-costed horizon EPS ($14.78), about 9 turns under the 23.7x costed peer median, or ~16x mid-cycle EPS: that would most likely mean the AI-optics test build has rolled over (book-to-bill below 1 after Q3's 1.13, transceiver digestion), a China entity-list/retaliation shock, or margins back to the FY24-25 ~26%, not ordinary 45%-vol noise around a $327 median.

reverse_dcf_check: 20.8x ex-SBC (22.8x SBC-costed) NTM P/E at the horizon on FY28 EPS ~$16.2 (a 4.4% costed earnings yield) implies roughly 8-9% earnings growth for a decade at ~33% non-GAAP margins and ~9% cost of equity, i.e. the optics market slowing to ~20% by 2031 with KEYS capture still falling and margins holding above the 28.7% mid-cycle; plausible given the costed digestion and China risks, and why 25% sits on the mid-cycle leg.

sbc_treatment.note: Counted once. The engine values ex-SBC (non-GAAP) EPS with shares -1%/yr net of SBC issuance and buybacks; the peers are mostly SBC-costed (RAL and AME adjusted EPS do not exclude SBC, Anritsu IFRS; only VIAV excludes it and is converted 18.8x -> 21.4x), so the costed multiple is converted onto the engine's ex-SBC EPS by 0.913 (horizon NTM SBC $1.41/share after 14% tax on 16.19). Round 1 wrongly said the peers were adjusted ex-SBC; this correction lowers the P/E leg relative to an unconverted 23.7x by ~9%. FY25 SBC 162M (3.0% of revenue), TTM 214M.

reasoning: Round 2. Kept the Kilian-approved quarterly driver set unchanged (industry evidence: LightCounting optics +120%/+76%, hyperscaler capex up, Advantest raise, VIAV data-center strength; Teradyne's flat guide and LightCounting's July correction warning on the other side). Supervisor findings accepted after checking: (1) SBC basis: I opened Ralliant Q2 2026 Ex.99.1 (adjusted EPS excludes amortization, M&A, restructuring, not SBC) and Viavi Q4 FY26 Ex.99.1 (excludes SBC; FY26 SBC 55.4M), so peers are SBC-costed and VIAV is converted to 21.4x; the median becomes 23.7x costed on 4 whole-company peers (TER, Advantest, FTV moved to segment-only: KEYS makes no ATE, and post-spin Fortive matches only part of EISG). Own costed NTM 23.65x sits at the median, so k=0.8 changes little (23.66x); I deduct 0.85x for costed post-horizon risks (optics digestion 0.30 x -3.5, later China rule 0.10 x -1.5, 3.2T/6G 0.35 x +1.0; supervisor -0.75) and convert by 0.913 to 20.8x on the engine's ex-SBC EPS $16.19 = $337. (2) Mid-cycle margin now the FY23-26 average 28.7% (proxy LTP actuals 30.3/26.3/26.0% opened, plus FY26 32.2%), EPS $13.79 x 21.6x = $298, weight 0.25 (judgment; forward earnings are the better-tested method). Blend $327.1 (engine). (3) Print date 2026-11-19 (company release). Scenarios keep the same driver deltas (China shock -50% within wireless -10% / EI -12% / capture -30%, margins -4pt, -5 turns; upside capture +25%, margins +1-2pt, +4 turns): P10 $191, P90 $439 (fatter left tail). Thesis break $218 (~14.75x costed horizon EPS). I did not copy the supervisor's $332 / $198 / $455; my lower target comes from the larger risk deduction and the lower mid-cycle multiple. Research limited to 7 follow-up queries/fetches.

FY growth = 1/3 x market growth (manufacturing test scales with units) + 2/3 x R&D growth (estimate +25% FY27, +15% FY28, +10% FY29; no source, the main judgment): FY27 +42.0% -> 2,685, FY28 +20.2% -> 3,228, FY29 +15.7% -> 3,734. Quarterly market = log-linear interpolation through each CY midpoint, rescaled so each FY sums to its CY total; forecast wireline quarters grow at one constant quarterly rate per year from the prior quarter so the FY totals hold (FY27 +5.6%/qtr, FY28 +4.2%/qtr, FY29 +3.4%/qtr), capture = wireline / market. Capture FY26 5.21% -> FY27 4.20%, FY28 3.87%, FY29 3.52%. Variant: slower R&D (+15/+10/+5%) gives CC 4,526/5,076/5,571. Supply constrains conversion for several quarters (CFO, Q3 FY26 call).

model_inputs.gap_note: Industry-lane views against the approved drivers, not in the set: wl_capture easing 5.2% -> 4.2% in FY27 is reasonable (KEYS is R&D-heavy test; VIAV says production test grows fastest); the FY28 optics market +30.6% is the main post-horizon exposure, carried as a multiple deduction. Round 2: SBC basis corrected (peers costed, x0.913), TER/Advantest/FTV moved to segment-only, mid-cycle margin on FY23-26. Weight 0.25 on the mid-cycle leg (supervisor 0.30) is judgment: Liu-Nissim-Thomas favour forward earnings; 0.30 would move the target ~-0.5%. No financing event >=20% (net cash). China-Taiwan tail (~6%, Polymarket via the supervisor) sits below the P10 and is not in the base. Q4 FY26 print Thursday 2026-11-19 after the close.
